messages.subject: including other 'source' files to shinyapps.io
parts:
when i run my shiny apps locally i often have several source() calls in my server.R file to load in general utility functions that i use across my apps.  How can simply deploy these utility.R files to shinyapps.io and modify my source() calls in my server.R file to reference them in the deployed shinyapps.io environment?

right now, my workaround is to manually copy/paste all the utility functions to the top of server.R before running deployApp() which is pretty time consuming

thanks!

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] including other 'source' files to shinyapps.io
parts:
There is nothing in the docs :)  It is something I just started experimenting with to try and solve the problem that shinyapps bundles the directory (and sub-directories) when it pushes up to ShinyApps.io so you can't reference files that are not in there.

In your case, you would probably want to do something like the following from the directory that contains your ui.R and server.R:

> ln -s myUtilities ~/myUtilities

and change your source call to:  source("myUtilities/utilityfunctions.R")

Let me know if that works for you.
